PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 20, 2024
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00 AM

Robert Livingstone, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Susan Redfield, Vice Chair  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Silissa Uriarte Smith, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Brent Dennis, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL PUBLIC COMMENTS TO
  CHRISTINE.AMAYA@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee of the Month – May 2024

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-53710  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, May 16, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-53711  Recommendation to consider approval or denial, of the fee waiver requests outlined
  in Attachment “A” in accordance with the Fee Waiver policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-53712  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute Personal Service Agreements with various contractors to provide free
  public cultural arts programs at Department of Parks, Recreation and Marine
  facilities, for a period of two years and one month from September 1, 2024 to
  September 30, 2026, with two, two-year options to renew through September 30,
  2030, at the discretion of the Director. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-53713  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to

  assign Right-of-Entry permit No. P-00243, and any other necessary documents, to
  Social and Environmental Entrepreneurs, Inc., a Delaware Corporation, on behalf of
  Sowing Seeds of Change, to operate an urban agriculture site at 620 San
  Francisco Avenue and to extend the term to September 30, 2027, with an option for
  one (1) additional, three-year renewal at the discretion of the Director. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-53714  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  approve an annual field improvement to the goal areas of fields 6 and 7 at
  Heartwell Park and to issue all documents necessary for a Right-of-Entry Permit to
  the American Youth Soccer Organization, a California nonprofit corporation, for a
  period of two months from June 1, 2024, through July 31, 2024; with three, one-
  year renewal options for the same two-month period in 2025, 2026, and 2027, at
  the discretion of the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine, or designee. (District
  5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-53715  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation of the Martin Luther King Jr
  Park Vision Plan. (District 6)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-53716  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation of the Scherer Park Vision Plan.
  (District 8)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-53717  Authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to execute a Right of Entry
  Permit, and any other necessary documents, with Public Corporation for the Arts of
  the City of Long Beach, dba Arts Council for Long Beach, a California nonprofit
  corporation, the production and maintenance of eight murals for a term of one year,
  from July 1, 2024, through June 30, 2025, with three, three-year renewal options at
  the discretion of the Director at the Bixby Park Community Center, Recreation Park
  Community Center, Dr. Thomas J. Clark Community Center at El Dorado Park,
  Heartwell Park Community Center, McBride Park Gymnasium, Ramona Park
  Community Center, Davenport Park, and on the 14th Street Basketball Courts.
  (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-53724  Recommendation to receive and file the Director’s monthly highlights report, “We
  Create Community” and “Director’s Highlights” for June 2024.
